name: CodeTrack
points: Designed relational PostgreSQL schemas to manage user data, coding challenges, and platform activity.
Developed REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js for communication between the frontend and database.
Designed and indexed database tables to support efficient data retrieval and structured data storage.

name: AI-Based Skin Lesion Classification (HAM10000)
points: Performed exploratory data analysis and preprocessing on the HAM10000 skin lesion dataset to analyze class distribution, identify class imbalance, and prepare image data for classification.
Used Python, Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for data analysis and visualization.

name: Salary Prediction
points: Developed a web-based salary prediction application with a user-friendly frontend using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Created an interactive form to collect user inputs such as experience, education, and job role and send them to the prediction backend.
